main.description: Get the current commit for an account's permissioned repo within a space. Served by a repo host. Callable with either OAuth (for the authenticated user's own data) or a space credential (for syncing services). When called with a space credential, the caller must send an Atproto-Space-Want-Mac header, and the commit's MAC is returned in the Atproto-Space-Mac response header.

repo.description: The DID of the account whose latest commit to retrieve.

errors.name: BadSpaceMac
errors.description: The Atproto-Space-Want-Mac header is missing or malformed, names an unsupported type or version, or carries an invalid key share.
